requirements.statement: The system shall allow public sign-up as Recruit only, email/password login, and logout using the approved eight-hour opaque server-session contract.
requirements.verification_method: API and Playwright tests for successful and rejected sign-up/login flows

requirements.statement: The system shall maintain a profile containing name, email, role, department, and start date; users may edit their own non-role fields while role and assignment changes remain Admin-managed.
requirements.verification_method: API schema/authorization tests and Playwright own-profile display/edit tests

requirements.statement: The system shall enforce Recruit access to owned records, Manager access to assigned recruits' records, and Admin access to all records, with create/view/edit/delete permitted within each scope.
requirements.verification_method: Role-matrix authorization tests for every protected API and UI operation

requirements.statement: The system shall allow an Admin to create, view, edit, and delete users, manage roles and manager-to-recruit assignments, and create, view, edit, and delete all diary data.
requirements.verification_method: Admin API and Playwright tests plus non-admin denial tests

requirements.statement: Authorized actors shall create, view, edit, and delete scoped task entries with date, title, description, category, status, and priority, and filter tasks by date, category, or status.
requirements.verification_method: Task API CRUD/filter tests and Playwright task-log scenarios

requirements.statement: Authorized users shall create, view, edit, and delete scoped issues with date, title, description, severity, status, and resolution notes, and filter issues by status or severity.
requirements.verification_method: Issue CRUD/filter/authorization tests and Playwright issue-log scenarios

requirements.statement: Authorized users shall create, view, edit, and delete scoped onboarding feedback with date, subject, type, and details, where type is Positive, Suggestion, or Concern.
requirements.verification_method: Feedback API validation tests and Playwright submission scenarios

requirements.statement: Authorized users shall create, view, edit, and delete scoped additional notes with date, title, content, and zero to ten normalized tags.
requirements.verification_method: Note API/tag validation tests and Playwright note-entry scenarios

requirements.statement: The dashboard shall show scoped counts for all four diary categories and the ten most recent scoped entries using the approved deterministic order.
requirements.verification_method: Seeded API aggregation tests and Playwright dashboard display tests

requirements.statement: The dashboard shall show completed tasks divided by all tasks as a rounded whole percent and shall treat Open and In Progress issues as open.
requirements.verification_method: Seeded boundary tests for progress/open-issue calculations and Playwright display tests

requirements.statement: The system shall generate one-recruit reports over an inclusive date range containing tasks, issues, feedback, or the approved combined superset contract.
requirements.verification_method: Report query tests with boundary dates and each content selection

requirements.statement: The system shall provide authorized reports as parseable UTF-8 RFC 4180 CSV or readable PDF files using the approved columns, metadata, ordering, empty-result behavior, and filename.
requirements.verification_method: Artifact tests for media type, filename, parseability, content, and authorization

requirements.statement: A Manager shall generate reports only for recruits assigned by an Admin; an Admin may report on any recruit and a Recruit only on self.
requirements.verification_method: Authorization tests using assigned and unassigned recruit fixtures

requirements.statement: The application shall keep all core flows usable in current Playwright Chromium at 390x844 and 1280x720 under the approved overflow and control-access rules.
requirements.verification_method: Playwright tests in current Chromium at 390x844 and 1280x720

requirements.statement: Application data shall be stored in a single-process in-memory SQLite database and may be lost on every backend restart.
requirements.source: Invocation requested_stack.database and BRD page 2, Technical Notes
requirements.verification_method: Integration tests for in-process storage and restart data loss/bootstrap behavior

requirements.statement: The frontend shall use React with Vite and Tailwind CSS, and the backend shall use Python FastAPI.
requirements.verification_method: Repository dependency/configuration inspection and startup smoke test

requirements.statement: The system shall enforce the approved validation and authorization contracts and show the approved field, login, access-denied, not-found, retryable server, and report-failure states.
requirements.source: Derived from the need for testable authentication, forms, APIs, and report generation
requirements.verification_method: Negative API tests and Playwright field/login/access/not-found/server/report failure scenarios

requirements.statement: Two additional features are explicitly deferred from this MVP and shall receive a separate post-MVP specification after the core application is implemented and proven.
requirements.verification_method: Manifest and scope review proving E006/G-H are excluded from MVP generation and execution waves
